messages:
Rina: Flagging a customer report: churned tokens around a mid-stream toolcall + region failover. They saw a transient 600 token provisional charge that never reconciled after the client closed the stream.

Vik: Can you share the router trace & billing ids?

Rina: request=rc-441, hops: pool-us-east -> pool-eu-west (auto-failover), toolcall `annotate_text` at t+85ms, client closed at t+320ms. Billing shows `provisional: 598` at t+350s but never moved to final attach. Ledger later shows `final attach: 598` but to rc-442 (a later session).

Rina: Snippet: ```
[6850012345] request=rc-441 route=us-east->eu-west failover=auto
[6850012430] toolcall id=tc-201 annotate_text tokens=112
[6850012560] client EOF, stream closed by client
[6850012750] provisional ledger record rc=rc-441 tokens=598 provisional=true
[6850012900] final attach rc=rc-442 tokens=598
```

Diego: Sounds like session id reassignment during the failover caused the attach to point at the new session. We currently key provisional->final by `session_id` only. Need a stable id across reconnects.

Vik: Agreed. Proposal: introduce `accounting_context` (UUID) emitted at the edge, propagated in the internal request envelope. Ledger/provisioning will key on `accounting_context` first, fallback to `session_id`. That should make attach idempotent across handoffs.

matt-billing-bot: Current pipeline: provisional records use `session_id` as primary key. We'll need a migration plan to accept the new primary key and backfill any recent provisional records that can be matched by timestamp + tenant + approximate token amounts. Also add `route_pool` tag for debugging.

Rina: UX: support needs a quick view of dangling provisional tokens per tenant and per route_pool, with clickable trace to router hops. Can we add a console alert when provisional > 0 after 10 minutes?

Vik: Implementation notes: (1) add header `X-Accounting-Context` opt-in for now; runtime will add if absent. (2) propagate in router metadata, sidecars, and toolcall invocations. (3) ledger writes accept `accounting_context` + `dedupe_key` (for toolcalls).

Diego: One more edge: toolcall retries. If a toolcall times out and is retried, we must de-dupe by `dedupe_key` attached to the toolcall invocation (client-supplied toolcall id or generated id). Otherwise duplicate toolcall tokens leak.

matt-billing-bot: We'll implement dedupe in the billing pipeline: dedupe window = 2 minutes for toolcalls, 5 minutes for stream attaches. Accept `dedupe_key` as optional, fallback to (session_id, timestamp bucket).

Vik: Perf: accounting_context is 16 bytes UUID, trivial. Biggest change is updating rpc metadata plumbing and ensuring service mesh propagates it. I can coordinate with infra to add passthrough.

Rina: Short-term mitigation: router-side shim to copy original `accounting_session` into `route_meta.orig_session` on handoff, and ledger can check that field when resolving provisional records. Low-risk until full rollout.

deploy-bot: Note: I triggered a canary deploy of the router shim to pool-us-east-canary at 2026-03-23T14:10:00Z.

Diego: Owners: Vik (router + mesh), Matt/billing (pipeline + dedupe), Rina (support console + alert), Diego (ledger attach changes). Sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to review PRs.

Rina: I'll add the customer repro + impact note to the ticket and create the console mock for the provisional dashboard. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
